a3.about: Ascend A3, 16 dies a node, 64 GB a die. The budget leaves the runtime its own reserve. The ratios turn ND's score into a step time in ms; they were fitted on five launches of 30 September 2026 (see a3.json). The spread is how far the same layout's step time moved between two rounds on different node sets (six layouts, 0.013 to 0.790%): two layouts closer than that cannot be told apart by one round.
